## Purpose

Panels produced:

- **Cox forest:** BRCA + SCAN-B Cox models of `Surv ~ age + Deviation`,
  including PAM50-adjusted aggregate and within-subtype rows. Stacked
  vertically (TCGA on top, SCAN-B on bottom), shared x-axis. HR colored
  blue when HR<1 (more youth-like = worse) and red when HR>1 (less
  youth-like = worse).

- **KM curves:** by within-cohort deviation tertile, both cohorts.
  Stacked vertically with shared x-axis (time in years). SCAN-B
  follow-up ends earlier; that asymmetry is honest representation.

- **Pathway × PAM50:** per-pathway mean φ across PAM50 subtypes for both
  cohorts. Six pathways. NAT anchored leftmost (TCGA only).

Endpoint: **Overall Survival (OS)** in both cohorts.

Some panels may not appear in the published manuscript. Panels are assembled
and typeset in Adobe Illustrator to produce the final figure.

## Helpers

```{r helpers}
get_patient12 <- function(x) substr(as.character(x), 1, 12)

harmonize_pam50 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "Unclassified"
  x <- dplyr::recode(x, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")
  factor(x, levels = c("Normal-Like", "LumA", "LumB", "Her2", "Basal", "Unclassified"))
}

cox_term <- function(df, formula_str, term_name) {
  fit <- survival::coxph(stats::as.formula(formula_str), data = df)
  co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  if (!term_name %in% rownames(co)) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(
    HR      = exp(co[term_name, "coef"]),
    CI_low  = exp(co[term_name, "coef"] - 1.96 * co[term_name, "se(coef)"]),
    CI_high = exp(co[term_name, "coef"] + 1.96 * co[term_name, "se(coef)"]),
    p_value = co[term_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )
}
```

## Load TCGA-BRCA + build phi

```{r load_brca}
proc_dir <- file.path(params$out_root, params$brca_analysis_id)
suffix   <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)

metadata_brca    <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "sample_metadata.rds"))
clockshap_bundle <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clockshap_objects", suffix, ".rds")))
clinical         <- utils::read.csv(
  params$clinical_csv,
  na.strings        = c("NA", "", "#N/A"),
  stringsAsFactors  = FALSE,
  check.names       = TRUE
)

# Take everything from the saved cs object — no recomputation.
cs_brca  <- clockshap_bundle$pt
phi_brca <- cs_brca$phi
dev_brca <- cs_brca$deviation
age_pt   <- cs_brca$age
ids_brca <- rownames(phi_brca)
feat     <- colnames(phi_brca)   # feature/pathway names, needed for SCAN-B alignment

# Adjacent normal (TCGA-BRCA only), the NAT anchor in the pathway × PAM50 panel.
phi_nat <- clockshap_bundle$nat$phi
dev_nat <- clockshap_bundle$nat$deviation
age_nat <- clockshap_bundle$nat$age
```

## Load SCAN-B + build phi

```{r load_scanb}
stopifnot(file.exists(params$scanb_inputs_rds))
scanb_inputs <- readRDS(params$scanb_inputs_rds)
stopifnot(all(feat %in% rownames(scanb_inputs$ssgsea_scores)))

X_scanb  <- t(scanb_inputs$ssgsea_scores[feat, , drop = FALSE])
scanb_cd <- scanb_inputs$coldata
common   <- intersect(rownames(scanb_cd), rownames(X_scanb))
scanb_cd <- scanb_cd[common, , drop = FALSE]
X_scanb  <- X_scanb[common, , drop = FALSE]

# Named age vector — ClockSHAP requires names(age) to match rownames(features).
age_scanb <- stats::setNames(as.numeric(scanb_cd$age_years), rownames(scanb_cd))
ok_s      <- is.finite(age_scanb)
X_scanb   <- X_scanb[ok_s, , drop = FALSE]
age_scanb <- age_scanb[ok_s]
scanb_cd  <- scanb_cd[ok_s, , drop = FALSE]

# Compute cs_scanb via the ClockSHAP API using the saved BRCA reference.
# Same call as the deviation figure — no hand-rolled GTEx-line math here.
cs_scanb  <- ClockSHAP::clockshap(
  features  = X_scanb,
  age       = age_scanb,
  clock     = clockshap_bundle$clock,
  reference = clockshap_bundle$reference
)
phi_scanb <- cs_scanb$phi
dev_scanb <- cs_scanb$deviation

# Sanity: invariant from the deviation script
stopifnot(max(abs(rowSums(phi_scanb) - dev_scanb)) < 1e-8)
```

## Assemble OS survival data frames

```{r assemble_surv}
# Canonical PAM50 ordering with NAT anchor for the pathway × PAM50 panel
pam50_order <- c("Adjacent Normal", "Normal-Like", "LumA", "LumB", "Her2", "Basal")

# ---- TCGA-BRCA OS ----
tum_brca <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ids_brca,
  age_years = age_pt,
  Deviation = dev_brca,
  PAM50     = harmonize_pam50(metadata_brca[ids_brca, "Subtype_Selected"])
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(patient12 = get_patient12(metadata_brca[sample_id, "tcga.tcga_barcode"]))

clin2 <- clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(patient12 = get_patient12(bcr_patient_barcode)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient12, .keep_all = TRUE)

surv_brca <- tum_brca %>%
  dplyr::left_join(clin2, by = "patient12") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS.time)),
    event  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS)) == 1,
    cohort = "TCGA-BRCA"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(time), !is.na(event), is.finite(age_years),
                is.finite(Deviation), !is.na(PAM50), PAM50 != "Unclassified") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PAM50 = factor(droplevels(factor(PAM50)), levels = pam50_order))

# ---- SCAN-B OS ----
# phi_scanb / dev_scanb / age_scanb / scanb_cd are all parallel-aligned
# (same rownames; enforced in load_scanb after the is.finite(age) filter).
scanb_ids  <- rownames(phi_scanb)
surv_scanb <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = scanb_ids,
  age_years = age_scanb[scanb_ids],
  Deviation = dev_scanb,                                 # aligned to phi by construction
  PAM50     = harmonize_pam50(scanb_cd[scanb_ids, "SSP.PAM50"]),
  time      = as.numeric(scanb_cd[scanb_ids, "OS_days"]),
  event     = as.numeric(scanb_cd[scanb_ids, "OS_event"]) > 0,
  cohort    = "SCAN-B"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(time), !is.na(event), is.finite(age_years),
                is.finite(Deviation), !is.na(PAM50), PAM50 != "Unclassified") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PAM50 = factor(droplevels(factor(PAM50)), levels = pam50_order))

cohort_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  surv_brca  %>% dplyr::summarise(cohort = "TCGA-BRCA (OS)", n = dplyr::n(), events = sum(event)),
  surv_scanb %>% dplyr::summarise(cohort = "SCAN-B (OS)",    n = dplyr::n(), events = sum(event))
)
knitr::kable(cohort_summary, caption = "OS cohort sizes after filtering.")
```

# Cox forest (stacked, shared x-axis)

Aggregate `age + Deviation`, PAM50-adjusted aggregate, and within-subtype
rows for both cohorts. No event-count filter — Normal-Like in TCGA shows
with wide CI for directional context. HR < 1 in blue (younger-looking
tumors at higher risk), HR > 1 in red (older-looking tumors at higher
risk).

```{r panelA_table}
run_aggregate_set <- function(df, cohort_label) {
  rows <- list()

  rows[[1]] <- cox_term(
    df, "survival::Surv(time, event) ~ age_years + Deviation", "Deviation"
  ) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "All tumors",
                      n = nrow(df), events = sum(df$event))

  if (nlevels(droplevels(df$PAM50)) > 1) {
    rows[[2]] <- cox_term(
      df, "survival::Surv(time, event) ~ age_years + Deviation + PAM50", "Deviation"
    ) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "All tumors (PAM50-adjusted)",
                        n = nrow(df), events = sum(df$event))
  }

  sub_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(levels(droplevels(df$PAM50)), function(s) {
    d <- dplyr::filter(df, PAM50 == s)
    # Bare-minimum Cox feasibility floor (need at least 2 events for a model)
    if (nrow(d) < 5 || sum(d$event) < 2) return(NULL)
    res <- cox_term(
      d, "survival::Surv(time, event) ~ age_years + Deviation", "Deviation"
    )
    if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
    res %>% dplyr::mutate(
      model = paste("Subtype:", s),
      n = nrow(d), events = sum(d$event)
    )
  })

  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows, sub_rows)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(out)
  out %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cohort      = cohort_label,
      sig         = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"),
      hr_dir      = ifelse(HR < 1, '"youth-like" deviation, increased risk',
                                   'less "youth-like" deviation, increased risk')
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(cohort, model, n, events, HR, CI_low, CI_high, p_value, sig, hr_dir)
}

panelA_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  run_aggregate_set(surv_brca,  "TCGA-BRCA (OS)"),
  run_aggregate_set(surv_scanb, "SCAN-B (OS)")
)

knitr::kable(panelA_tbl, digits = 4,
             caption = "OS Cox forest data, all subtypes shown.")
```

```{r panelA_plot, fig.width=3.7, fig.height=4.0}

    hr_dir = factor(hr_dir,
                    levels = c('"youth-like" deviation, increased risk',

  scale_colour_manual(values = hr_pal, name = NULL) +
```

# KM by deviation tertile (stacked, shared x-axis)

Within-cohort deviation tertiles. T1 = most youth-like (most negative
deviation), T3 = least youth-like (least negative deviation). Both cohorts
share a time axis; SCAN-B follow-up ends earlier than TCGA's, which is
visible as the SCAN-B curves stopping at a shorter x-value.

```{r panelB_data}
add_dev_tertile <- function(df) {
  qs <- stats::quantile(df$Deviation, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  # cut() assigns the lowest 1/3 of values to the FIRST label.
  # Since deviation is signed and predominantly negative in tumor cohorts,
  # the most-negative third = most youth-like = T1.
  df$dev_tertile <- cut(
    df$Deviation, breaks = qs,
    labels = c('T1: Most "youth-like"', "T2: Middle", 'T3: Least "youth-like"'),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )
  df
}

km_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  add_dev_tertile(surv_brca)  %>% dplyr::mutate(cohort = "TCGA-BRCA (OS)"),
  add_dev_tertile(surv_scanb) %>% dplyr::mutate(cohort = "SCAN-B (OS)")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cohort      = factor(cohort, levels = c("TCGA-BRCA (OS)", "SCAN-B (OS)")),
    dev_tertile = factor(dev_tertile,
                         levels = c('T1: Most "youth-like"', "T2: Middle", 'T3: Least "youth-like"'))
  )

# Truncation horizon = SCAN-B's natural max follow-up. We administratively
# censor BOTH the plot data (km_curves) and the log-rank test (survdiff) at
# this horizon so the panel is internally consistent: visual range and the
# reported p-value cover the same patient-time. SCAN-B is effectively
# untouched (no events past this point); TCGA's late tail is censored,
# which slightly tightens the test (full vs trunc: chisq 6.95→7.19,
# p 0.031→0.027 in BRCA) but does not change the qualitative result.
x_max <- km_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(cohort == "SCAN-B (OS)") %>%
  dplyr::pull(time) %>%
  max(na.rm = TRUE) / 365.25

trunc_data <- function(d, t_max_years) {
  t_max_days <- t_max_years * 365.25
  d %>% dplyr::mutate(
    event = event & time <= t_max_days,
    time  = pmin(time, t_max_days)
  )
}

km_data_view <- trunc_data(km_data, x_max)

km_curves <- km_data_view %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cohort, dev_tertile) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(function(d, .) {
    if (nrow(d) < 5 || sum(d$event) < 1) return(tibble::tibble())
    fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, event) ~ 1, data = d)
    tibble::tibble(time = fit$time, surv = fit$surv,
                   n_risk = fit$n.risk, n_event = fit$n.event)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Per-cohort log-rank on truncated data (unadjusted — descriptive companion
# to the forest panel's age-adjusted Cox HR; see figure legend for division of labor).
lr_brca  <- survival::survdiff(
  survival::Surv(time, event) ~ dev_tertile,
  data = dplyr::filter(km_data_view, cohort == "TCGA-BRCA (OS)")
)
lr_scanb <- survival::survdiff(
  survival::Surv(time, event) ~ dev_tertile,
  data = dplyr::filter(km_data_view, cohort == "SCAN-B (OS)")
)
lr_p <- function(sd) 1 - stats::pchisq(sd$chisq, length(sd$n) - 1)

logrank_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  cohort         = c("TCGA-BRCA (OS)", "SCAN-B (OS)"),
  log_rank_chisq = c(lr_brca$chisq, lr_scanb$chisq),
  p_value        = c(lr_p(lr_brca), lr_p(lr_scanb))
)
knitr::kable(
  logrank_tbl, digits = 4,
  caption = sprintf(
    "Unadjusted log-rank test by deviation tertile, per cohort (administratively censored at %.2f years to match SCAN-B follow-up).",
    x_max
  )
)
```

```{r panelB_plot, fig.width=3.7, fig.height=4.0}
# x_max defined in panelB_data (= SCAN-B max follow-up, years).
# km_curves and the log-rank in panelB_data are already truncated to this
# horizon, so coord_cartesian below is just a redundant visual safety net.

logrank_labels <- logrank_tbl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cohort  = factor(cohort, levels = c("TCGA-BRCA (OS)", "SCAN-B (OS)")),
    p_label = dplyr::case_when(

    x = -Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.8,
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.4, colour = "grey20"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, x_max), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (years)",
    y = "Survival probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    panel.grid         = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
```

# Pathway × PAM50 mean φ (both cohorts)

Six pathways across PAM50 subtypes, both cohorts overlaid. Adjacent
Normal anchored leftmost as grey square (TCGA only). Reference at
φ = 0 (GTEx age expectation).

```{r panelC_data}
build_pathway_long <- function(surv_df, phi_mat, cohort_label, poi) {
  common <- intersect(surv_df$sample_id, rownames(phi_mat))
  surv_df <- surv_df[match(common, surv_df$sample_id), , drop = FALSE]
  phi_sub <- phi_mat[common, intersect(colnames(phi_mat), poi), drop = FALSE]

  as.data.frame(phi_sub) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "pathway", values_to = "phi") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      surv_df %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, age_years, PAM50, event),
      by = "sample_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cohort = cohort_label)
}

phi_long_c <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  build_pathway_long(surv_brca,  phi_brca,  "TCGA-BRCA (OS)", params$poi_pathways),
  build_pathway_long(surv_scanb, phi_scanb, "SCAN-B (OS)",    params$poi_pathways)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = params$poi_pathways),
    PAM50   = factor(PAM50,   levels = pam50_order)
  )

# NAT per-pathway (BRCA only)
phi_nat_sub <- phi_nat[, intersect(colnames(phi_nat), params$poi_pathways), drop = FALSE]
nat_long <- as.data.frame(phi_nat_sub) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "pathway", values_to = "phi") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    PAM50     = factor("Adjacent Normal", levels = pam50_order),
    cohort    = "TCGA-BRCA (OS)",
    event     = NA,
    age_years = age_nat[sample_id],
    pathway   = factor(pathway, levels = params$poi_pathways)
  )

phi_long_c <- dplyr::bind_rows(phi_long_c, nat_long) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PAM50 = factor(as.character(PAM50), levels = pam50_order))

phi_subtype_means <- phi_long_c %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cohort, pathway, PAM50) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n        = dplyr::n(),
    mean_phi = mean(phi, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_phi   = stats::sd(phi, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_phi   = sd_phi / sqrt(n),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PAM50 = factor(as.character(PAM50), levels = pam50_order))

knitr::kable(phi_subtype_means, digits = 3,
             caption = "Per-cohort, per-pathway, per-subtype mean φ, as plotted.")
```

```{r panelC_plot, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_panelC <- ggplot(phi_subtype_means,
                   aes(x = PAM50, y = mean_phi, group = cohort)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey70") +
  # Connecting line through tumor subtypes only
  geom_line(data = phi_subtype_means %>% dplyr::filter(PAM50 != "Adjacent Normal"),
            aes(colour = cohort),
            linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  # Tumor subtype points
  geom_point(data = phi_subtype_means %>% dplyr::filter(PAM50 != "Adjacent Normal"),
             aes(colour = cohort),
             shape = 16, size = 2.8) +
  # NAT — solid grey square, no outline
  geom_point(data = phi_subtype_means %>% dplyr::filter(PAM50 == "Adjacent Normal"),
             shape = 15, size = 3.2, colour = "#777777") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = pam50_order, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("TCGA-BRCA (OS)" = "#7b3294",   # purple
               "SCAN-B (OS)"    = "#e66101"),  # orange
    name = NULL
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ pathway, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue category",
    y = "Mean Deviation Per Pathway (ClockSHAP, years)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7, angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin        = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

p_panelC
```

```{r panelC_save}

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, "pathway_phi_by_pam50.pdf"),
    plot     = p_panelC,
    width    = 7,
    height   = 5,
    units    = "in"
  )
  message("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "pathway_phi_by_pam50.pdf"))
}
```
